target_name: Organic Intangible Tilt with Claims-Coverage Floor
rationale: This is a mechanical re-pairing of two already-tested legs ("Organic Minus Acquired Intangible Capital" and the oancf/(dlc+lct) worst-year coverage floor) whose only substantive change is dropping the redundant dlc from a denominator that already contains it, so it is a cosmetic variant highly likely to reproduce the archived 4.9% alpha rather than teach anything new.

target_name: Net Durable Intangible Capital Behind a Cash-Earnings Floor
rationale: Also a recombination of two archived legs, but the motivation is a genuine diagnostic (the netted-dollar construct has strong alpha with a flat FM slope, the cash-earnings floor the reverse) and it preserves the broad ~0.14 coverage instead of collapsing to the sparse oancf sample, so it is worth one test — though the two legs both embed debt and intangibles and may be too correlated to add much.

Once the telescoping TS_SUM of DELTA is unwound the expression is simply R&D intensity minus five-year net paid-in-capital growth, i.e. an additive blend of two well-known published anomalies (R&D intensity and net equity issuance/composite issuance) and a functional-form restatement of the archived gen-6 dilution signal, so a strong slope would be uninformative about anything new.

target_name: Same-Horizon Build Minus Buy with Cash Floor
rationale: The horizon-mismatch critique is correct and the fix is internally consistent (TS_SUM of DELTA telescopes to a clean five-year change in booked intangibles), but the archive already showed flow and stock versions of the acquired-intangible penalty perform nearly identically (fmb 4.78 vs 4.59), so the expected incremental information is modest and partly overlaps known acquisition/asset-growth effects.

This is the eleventh instance of the same template — MIN(R&D intensity, some ranked profitability leg) — and five-year Δre/at is close to cumulative ROA net of dividends, overlapping both the archived retained-earnings gate and the published retained-earnings/profitability literature, so it is too incremental to be worth a slot.

A single clean leg with no rank splice that applies a specific, previously informative transformation (the five-year floor) to an intangible-augmented cash gross profitability ratio; it overlaps gross profitability and intangible-adjusted-capital literature and the archived penalized-capital floor, but the income-statement construction, broader coverage, and the level-vs-floor diagnostic make it a substantive rather than cosmetic test.
